title: HoroConsultant HF Docker Release Manifest v1
description: Closed deterministic bundle contract for the canonical Hugging Face Docker backend. The publisher must build this exact object from one clean packaging commit in both dry-run and live modes. Entries must be unique and sorted by destination path using UTF-8 byte order; total_files must equal the entry count and total_bytes must equal the sum of staged_bytes. JSON Schema validates shape while the publisher enforces sorting, cross-field equality, sums, source ancestry, source/staged parity, and path collision rules.

packaging_commit.description: Full clean Git revision whose tracked blobs and generator code produced the staged bundle.

release_source_commit.description: Lowercase abbreviated or full source commit carried by the canonical release metadata and version suffix.

release_source_revision.description: Full revision resolved from release_source_commit; it must be an ancestor of packaging_commit.

entries.description: Complete desired remote tree, sorted by path. Duplicate destination paths are forbidden even when the remaining entry fields differ.

total_bytes.description: Exact sum of staged_bytes across entries.

manifest_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of json.dumps(the complete object with manifest_sha256 omitted, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8'), with no trailing newline. The digest is identical for approved dry-run and live staging.

path.description: Canonical POSIX destination path in the Space repository.

source_path.description: Tracked repository path or stable in-source generator locator; never a temporary or absolute path.

source_blob_oid.description: Git blob OID for tracked input; null only for a deterministic generated entry.

source_mode.description: Required local regular-file baseline. HfApi does not provide portable remote chmod control.

staged_blob_oid.description: Expected Git blob OID calculated from the exact staged bytes.
